craft_notes: Sthāyin: measure. Rows: span then fitness. Read aloud: measured pace.

lines: Heart to twelve's-end, by own fingers, thirty-six
the breath-road runs, out and in, each fitly thewed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra hṛdayāt dvādaśāntāntaṃ svāṅgulaiḥ sarvasya ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulaḥ prāṇacāraḥ nirgame praveśe ca svocitabalayatnadehatvāt sarvasya
